controls.rule: Fresh release receipt before every lateral move; acquisition requires stationary contact.
Calibration identity includes probe or lever plus setup/mount/version and metric.
A current out-of-contact optical baseline is mandatory for optical calibration/response.
Correct target and registered region required; independent AFM depth is a reference observation, never ground-truth injected as actor input.
Raw frame and force records precede reconstruction and are immutable.
Release, supported retrieval, post-inspection, archive and cleanup precede bounded-route closure.
